summary: The first screen mismatch is the swallowed-hero light transition in mhitu.c:gulpmu: after swallowed(1), its non-flaming branch walks hero inventory and calls apply.c:snuff_lit before digest messages. C turns a carried lit oil lamp off and prints “Your lamp goes out!”; JavaScript currently records note_unported and leaves it lit. The queue’s RNG attribution to zap.c:obj_resists is a separate unresolved event at the same input step; the accepted manifest cautions that it is secondary and does not establish the caller. Fix the source-ordered gulp light call and then re-evaluate the residual RNG path.

source.branch: On the first engulf transition, after swallowed(1), if the engulfer is not flaming, gulpmu iterates the hero inventory in linked-list order and calls apply.c:snuff_lit for each object. The call result is discarded. For a lit oil lamp in OBJ_INVENT, snuff_lit emits its visibility-gated message and calls timeout.c:end_burn before gulpmu continues into digestion handling.
callers: mattacku() dispatches a monster engulf attack to mhitu.c:gulpmu().
dependencies: The relevant callee is apply.c:snuff_lit(); its lamp branch uses timeout.c:end_burn(). JavaScript already has end_burn() and snuff_candle(), but the existing snuff_monster_light() helper requires OBJ_MINVENT and cannot handle gulpmu’s OBJ_INVENT objects.

The current queue’s obj_resists(zap.c:1469) RNG annotation identifies the source of the C draw, not its caller. The v40 manifest and replay establish the visible lamp miss; the RNG residual needs a separate source trace after this correction.

evidence: Queue provenance: .cache/latest-saved-combined-queue.json (SHA-256 5943c7589ed17bc79c79f8eb5ce26173498e1301ce17ea080e6f0b5563201262), session synthetic/v40/v40-snuffed-lit-lamp-on-engulfing-worm. Its accepted 4c7e8745 v40 evaluation is 76/79 screens, 2812/2825 RNG calls, and 79/79 cursors; first screen mismatch boundary is 77, with C cell “Y” and JS “T”.

The case source trace in challenges/manifests/v40.json names mhitu.c:gulpmu -> apply.c:snuff_lit -> timeout.c:end_burn. Its C outcome records “Your lamp goes out!” before digestion and explicitly treats the obj_resists RNG difference as secondary without an established caller.

Upstream mhitu.c:1389-1400 sets uswallow, calls swallowed(1), then—under !flaming(mtmp->data)—walks gi.invent and discards snuff_lit(otmp2) before continuing digestion. Upstream apply.c:1497-1512 has the lamplit lamp/pot-oil branch; it checks visibility, prints with Yname2()/otense(), calls end_burn(), and returns TRUE.

In js/mhitu.js:2289-2293 the matching inventory loop calls note_unported("light.c snuff_lit") instead. js/apply_splash_lit.js:121-143 has only a monster-inventory helper that throws unless OBJ_MINVENT; gulpmu’s state.invent entries are OBJ_INVENT. js/timeout.js:2099-2112 already ports end_burn().

A fresh differential of the admitted recipe at worker commit 40d9c7a70d0b3d097e124782460d5054458a6ffd reproduced the mismatch: C=2825 RNG, JS=2821; at segment 1 step 77 C logged rn2(100)=79 from obj_resists(zap.c:1469), JS logged rn2(1)=0; the screen at that boundary starts “Y” in C and “T” in JS.
